steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable the required vendor-lock configuration before creating the event.
Enable the required read-only price-cap configuration.
Set the event type to RFQ and establish the single-vendor awarding mode.
Provide the mandatory event title for a create test.
Choose the RFQ pricing template before adding the product.
Add the specified product and set its requested quantity to 10.
Confirm the product was added before testing the RFQ configuration control.
Record the product text to verify that opening configuration does not alter the event.
Click the RFQ event-type control to open its configuration window.
Verify that the configuration window opened.
Verify the configuration window exposes Event Type.
